# Thread Weaver

## Documentation Sets

- [Thread Weaver](https://weaver.yanawa.io/llms-full.txt)

## Docs

Every page below is available as raw markdown.

- [Overview](https://weaver.yanawa.io/raw/architecture/overview.md): Where the rules live, and where the browser calls live.
- [Page and state](https://weaver.yanawa.io/raw/architecture/page-and-state.md): How one editor is shared, and which edits pack the text again.
- [Splitting](https://weaver.yanawa.io/raw/architecture/splitting.md): How a source string becomes posts that fit a limit.
- [Installation](https://weaver.yanawa.io/raw/getting-started/installation.md): Run Thread Weaver locally with Bun.
- [Introduction](https://weaver.yanawa.io/raw/getting-started/introduction.md): What Thread Weaver does, and what it deliberately does not do.
- [Components](https://weaver.yanawa.io/raw/reference/components.md): The Vue files that draw the workbench.
- [Composables](https://weaver.yanawa.io/raw/reference/composables.md): The Vue layer that holds the editor and talks to the browser.
- [Splitting and compile](https://weaver.yanawa.io/raw/reference/splitting-and-compile.md): Packing, markers, bridges, and the text tools.
- [State and metrics](https://weaver.yanawa.io/raw/reference/state-and-metrics.md): Edits, totals, the ring, and the files you copy or send.
- [Types and limits](https://weaver.yanawa.io/raw/reference/types-and-limits.md): Platform caps, shared types, and the constants the editor starts from.
- [Markers and bridges](https://weaver.yanawa.io/raw/using-the-tool/markers-and-bridges.md): How counters and the custom bridge are written into each post.
- [Platforms](https://weaver.yanawa.io/raw/using-the-tool/platforms.md): The four character limits and what changes when you switch.
- [Shipping a thread](https://weaver.yanawa.io/raw/using-the-tool/shipping.md): Copy, download, listen, and send.
- [Text tools](https://weaver.yanawa.io/raw/using-the-tool/text-tools.md): Capitalize posts, finish sentences, and keep line breaks.
- [The workbench](https://weaver.yanawa.io/raw/using-the-tool/workbench.md): The parts of the page and what each one is for.

## Landing

Every page below is available as raw markdown.

- [Thread Weaver](https://weaver.yanawa.io/raw/index.md): Split a long post into posts that fit X, Bluesky, Threads, and Mastodon.
